name: memory_distill_insights
content: Consolidate and deduplicate the following collection of raw insights.
## Source Insights ({tier_count} tiers)
{source_json}
## Target Tier Schema
{tier_schema}
## Instructions
1. Identify insights that describe the same or overlapping patterns
2. Merge overlapping insights into a single refined version
3. When merging, keep the more specific and higher-confidence formulation

4. Preserve and combine provenance only through fields declared in the target item schema. If that schema declares `evidence_count`, sum valid counts; otherwise do not emit `evidence_count`. Use declared provenance fields such as `evidence` or `source_episodes` when available
5. Detect conflicting insights and list them separately
6. If the target schema declares confidence and the merged confidence is below 0.3, drop the insight
7. When newer evidence explicitly supersedes an older value, keep only the current value in the active insight; do not repeat the obsolete value in parentheses or explanatory history
8. Every field and value shape in each output insight must conform exactly to the target tier schema provided above. Omit information for which the schema has no field rather than inventing a field
## Merge Strategy
- Two insights overlap if they describe the same entity preference or behavioral pattern
- Prefer specificity: "prefers VS Code for Python" beats "prefers VS Code"
- Resolve temporal conflicts by preferring the more recent evidence
- If two insights genuinely contradict, do not merge; list them as a conflict
Return the JSON object as specified by your system prompt.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no code blocks, no prose.

variables.name: source_json
variables.description: JSON-serialized array of raw insights to consolidate and deduplicate
examples: [{"pattern": "User prefers dark mode", "confidence": 0.8, "source_episodes": ["episode-1"]}, {"pattern": "User consistently enables a dark theme", "confidence": 0.7, "source_episodes": ["episode-2"]}]

variables.name: tier_schema
variables.description: JSON schema describing the authoritative target tier structure for distilled insights

variables.name: tier_count
variables.description: Number of memory tiers the insights were collected from

metadata.description: User prompt instructing the LLM to consolidate and deduplicate raw insights while conforming exactly to the configured target tier schema.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.1.0: Makes confidence and evidence aggregation conditional on fields declared by the authoritative target tier schema, preventing off-schema consolidation output. v1.0.0: Initial insight distillation user prompt for memory consolidation pipeline.
